title: Les Aventures de Pascal / Scholia de Ménil (bilayer)
designed_property: 5x4x2 king bilayer, exact 2L UBG by construction (R_b=8.0 um, intra-layer 5 um, inter-layer 3 um)
note: This is the combined 40-atom bilayer that is the canonical paper instance (Table 5, §6.3). The literary text is split across the two component folders: pascal_apocryphe (20 pages, layer z=0) and pascal_apocryphe_scholia (20 pages, layer z=3 um).
paper: Jurczak 2026, arXiv (QOuLiPo: What a quantum computer sees when it reads a book)
